description: Post on the Parfumo forum from the user's account: reply in a topic (`topic` and `text`), or open a new topic (`category`, `subject` of 60 characters at most, and `text`). PUBLIC and subject to the forum rules. Parfumo forbids AI-generated text and restricts or deletes accounts that post it: only pass on text the user wrote themselves, unchanged; never compose or rewrite a post. Not idempotent: each call posts once more. On this server such writes stay in dry-run mode unless the operator enabled them, with a daily cap per user. These Parfumo routes were read in the site's forms but never exercised by this server. Supports dry_run. Requires a linked Parfumo account.

category.description: To open a topic: the forum category (`slug` or URL)…

dry_run.description: When true, nothing is sent: the answer shows the request that would be made.

subject.description: …and the subject of the new topic (60 characters at most).

text.description: Text of the post, in the user's own words.

topic.description: To reply: the topic (`slug`, topic URL or post URL).

name: parfumo_forum_post

WriteCall.description:
A write request to Parfumo, as built before being sent (also shown by `dry_run`).
The session `csrf_key` is added at send time and never appears here.

form.description: Form fields (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`), without the CSRF token.

dry_run.description: True when nothing was sent to Parfumo.

executed.description: True when at least one write request was sent.

notes.description: Side effects and things to know.

planned_requests.description: The write requests sent, or that would be sent (CSRF and form tokens omitted).

public_writes_enabled.description: Whether this server is allowed to send publicly visible writes (operator setting).

result_url.description: Parfumo URL of the result, when Parfumo returned one.

target.description: What the write is aimed at: member, forum topic, perfume…
